summary: A column's list place is one of the five the port names; a host whose store holds another word sends the column without a place.

then.note: columns[].list is an enum of status, title, supporting, fact and hidden, and a column has no other fields (additionalProperties false): a column with list: badge does not conform to data.columns, and a view that validates the answer refuses it. The host sends name with list: title and plan without list (or with a place of the five). A view given a value outside the five anyway treats the column as one without a place: it is left out of the list and drawn in the table as before.
